primitives.name: Forward Power-Mentality Duality
primitives.verbatim_quote: POSITION PLAY 91 The last word on the work of the forwards is this: If the battle belongs to the strong, it is theirs because they represent the power of the team.
primitives.assumptions: Power and mentality are independent variables; team strength is a function of P and M.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When P < threshold, M becomes dominant; when M < threshold, P fails.

layer2.mapping: Forward power and mentality map to GSI's probabilistic model of line effectiveness; P and M are latent variables in Bayesian inference.
layer2.telemetry: Line performance metrics (e.g., run defense efficiency, pass protection rate)

primitives.name: Center Positional Cognitive Load
primitives.verbatim_quote: The center, however, both on offense and defense, has additional vital duties.
primitives.assumptions: C is a composite of A, D, and P; each action contributes linearly to C.
primitives.breakdown_regime: C exceeds threshold when A > 1.0 or D + P > 1.5.

layer2.mapping: Center cognitive load maps to GSE's state transition kernel; C drives dynamic shifts in scrimmage positioning.
layer2.telemetry: Center reaction time, pass accuracy, defensive drop frequency

primitives.name: Scrimmage Positioning Adjustment
primitives.verbatim_quote: The line cannot get into position until he has adjusted himself over the ball.
primitives.assumptions: L = B + F; W affects stability and momentum transfer.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Adjustment fails when |L - B| > 0.3 meters or W < 0.6.

layer2.mapping: Positioning adjustment maps to GSI's kinematic state estimation; F and W are inputs to real-time motion prediction.
layer2.telemetry: Foot placement consistency, weight shift timing
